headline: Braskem Petrochemical Spreads Plunge Up to 43% in Third Quarter
summary: Brazilian petrochemical producer Braskem reported petchem spreads fell by up to 43% in the third quarter of 2026, driven by normalizing raw material costs and softening global demand following prior supply shocks.
why: Braskem is the largest thermoplastic resin producer in the Americas, with earnings heavily dependent on international naphtha and polymer margin spreads.

impacts.name: Braskem S.A.
impacts.why: A 43% contraction in international petrochemical spreads severely pressures operating margins.
